title: svc forbidden-tokens
description: Project-owned list of tokens that MUST NOT appear in framework-path files. Each consuming project maintains its own .svc/forbidden-tokens.json. The framework itself ships only the schema; the framework's own forbidden list (if any) lives in the framework's project-local config and contains only generic terms. Baselined 2026-05-12 by WI-341.

pattern.description: Substring or JS-style /regex/ flags pattern. Substring match by default. Wrap in / / for regex.

reason.description: Why this token is forbidden in framework paths. E.g., 'Example Marketplace WI-233 specific evidence token'.

scope.description: Optional path globs the rule applies to. Defaults to framework-path glob set when omitted.

added_at.description: Date the token was added to the list.

added_by.description: Source WI, review, or person that surfaced the forbidden token.

framework_path_globs.description: Path globs treated as framework-path (vs project-path). Defaults defined by validate-wi-promotion if omitted: ['scripts/**', 'hooks/**', 'references/**', 'test-framework/**', '*/SKILL.md'].
